title: Out of Office Beaches | 30A Escapes
meta_description: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Out of Office Beaches,” a spacious Seacrest Beach retreat made for pool days, beach days and plenty of time together. With 5 bedrooms, 5.5 baths and room for 14 guests, this two-story home gives families and groups plenty of space to settle
description_expanded: Description Description 30A ESCAPES presents… “Out of Office Beaches,” a spacious Seacrest Beach retreat made for pool days, beach days and plenty of time together. With 5 bedrooms, 5.5 baths and room for 14 guests, this two-story home gives families and groups plenty of space to settle in. Spend the morning with coffee on the front porch, head to the 12,000 Sq Ft Seacrest Lagoon Pool for the afternoon or grab one of the 7 included bikes and explore the east end of 30A. Back at home, multiple living areas and generous outdoor spaces make it just as easy to stay in, especially with a screened-in balcony complete with an outdoor kitchen, dining area and TV. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Spacious Seacrest Beach Retreat with 5 bedrooms, 5.5 bathrooms and accommodations for up to 14 guestsAccess to the 12,000 Sq Ft Seacrest Lagoon Pool with waterfalls, loungers and a zero-entry areaSeacrest Community Beach Access with seasonal tram service for easy beach daysSpacious Screened-In Balcony with outdoor living area, flat-screen TV, outdoor kitchen and al fresco diningMultiple Living Areas with comfortable gathering spaces on both floorsChef’s Kitchen with stainless steel appliances, wine cooler and beverage fridge7 Bikes Included for exploring Seacrest Beach and nearby 30A communities*** LIVING AREAS ***With comfortable gathering spaces on both floors, “Out of Office Beaches” gives everyone room to settle in after a day at the beach or pool. The first floor serves as the main gathering space with an open layout connecting the living, kitchen and dining areas, while the upstairs lounge provides another spot for movie nights or a little downtime.Spacious First-Floor Living Area with cozy sectional, electric fireplace and flat-screen TVSecond-Floor Living Area with flat-screen TV and direct access to the screened-in balcony*** KITCHEN & DINING ***The first-floor chef’s kitchen sits at the center of the home, making it easy to cook, gather and spend time together. Stainless steel appliances, plenty of seating and dedicated beverage storage keep everything convenient whether you’re making breakfast before the pool or dinner at home.Chef’s Kitchen with stainless steel appliances, wine cooler and mini beverage fridgeKitchen bar with seating for 4Dining area with seating for 10Outdoor kitchen on the second-floor screened-in balcony with gas grill and mini fridgeAl fresco dining for 6 on the screened-in balcony*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Five bedrooms are spread across both floors, including two King suites and two Queen suites with En-suite bathrooms. A spacious bunk room gives younger guests their own place to settle in while the two Primary King Suites offer comfortable retreats for the adults.1st FloorPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, patio access and En-suite with dual vanities, soaking tub and walk-in showerHalf Bath conveniently located off the kitchen and living area2nd FloorPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, access to the screened-in balcony and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in showerBunk Room: Two Twin-over-Full bunk beds and flat-screen TVGuest Bathroom: Single vanity and shower/tub combinationQueen Guest Suite: Queen bed, flat-screen TV, access to shared balcony and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in showerQueen Guest Suite: Queen bed, flat-screen TV, access to shared balcony and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in shower*** OUTDOOR LIVING ***Outdoor living is a big part of a stay at “Out of Office Beaches.” Start the morning with coffee on the welcoming front porch, then end the day upstairs on the spacious screened-in balcony. With its own outdoor kitchen, dining area, living space and TV, there’s plenty of room to grill dinner, watch a game or spend the evening outside.Inviting Front Porch perfect for morning coffeeSpacious Screened-In Balcony with comfortable outdoor living space and flat-screen TVOutdoor Kitchen with gas grill and mini fridgeAl Fresco Dining with seating for 6Shared Balcony accessible from both second-floor Queen Guest Suites*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in the heart of Seacrest Beach, “Out of Office Beaches” puts some of the east end of 30A’s best-known amenities right outside your door. Spend the day at the community’s 12,000 Sq Ft Lagoon Pool, catch the seasonal tram to the beach or grab one of the 7 included bikes and head toward neighboring Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Peddler’s Pavilion and nearby communities add plenty of options for dining, shopping, coffee and evenings out without having to venture far from home.12,000 Sq Ft Seacrest Lagoon Pool with waterfalls, loungers and zero-entry areaSeacrest Community Beach Access with seasonal tram service between designated neighborhood stops and the beachPeddler’s Pavilion nearby for dining, shopping and seasonal entertainmentAlys Beach and Rosemary Beach nearby for even more restaurants, coffee shops, boutiques and places to exploreScenic Highway 30A bike path nearby for exploring Seacrest Beach and surrounding communities7 Bikes Included for getting around the neighborhood and exploring 30A*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to access the 7 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesThere is an active Ring Doorbell at the entry door*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A ESCAPES, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 guest support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! *** Read less
